purpose: Development smoke set for the doc-04 executability gate: interface and hardware testing of the visual pipeline only. Not an accuracy benchmark; these cases never enter the final-test split (docs/planning/06).
labels_scope: development-only; authored from what a careful human sees in the pixels, never tuned against model output

cases.criterion: The Orbit Export window shows a large banner stating the export completed.
cases.objective: Check the Orbit Export tool for a final completion state after the nightly export job.
cases.rationale: A large green completion banner with readable text is plainly visible (doc-04 slot 1, large completion banner).

cases.criterion: The Vertex submissions window shows a large banner stating upload UPL-3388 was accepted.
cases.objective: Confirm the Vertex submission reached an accepted final state.
cases.rationale: The visible banner explicitly reads 'Submission rejected', contradicting the acceptance claim (doc-04 slot 2, large rejection banner).

cases.criterion: The profile form shows an inline error stating a required field is empty.
cases.objective: Check the new-profile form for validation errors before retrying submission.
cases.rationale: The email field is visibly empty with a red outline and a readable 'Email is required.' error (doc-04 slot 3, empty required field plus explicit error).

cases.criterion: The page shows a final confirmation that the survey response was submitted.
cases.objective: Verify the feedback survey response reached a submitted final state.
cases.rationale: The form is filled but no confirmation or error state is visible anywhere; one screenshot cannot establish submission (doc-04 slot 4, filled form without confirmation).

cases.criterion: The Fleet Deploy window shows a final completion state for the deployment.
cases.objective: Verify the Fleet deployment reached a completed final state.
cases.rationale: A spinner with 'Deploying' text and a partial progress bar show a nonfinal state; the evidence phase is pending, so strict policy abstains with PENDING_STATE without model execution (doc-04 slot 5, loading spinner with pending phase).

cases.criterion: The Sync Center window shows a completion banner confirming the sync finished.
cases.objective: Confirm the folder sync reached a completed final state.
cases.rationale: The two final screenshots carry conflicting banners (sync complete vs sync failed) for one criterion; contradiction resolves to unknown (doc-04 slot 6, two final screenshots with conflicting banners).

cases.criterion: The order details page shows order ORD-5542 with status 'cancelled'.
cases.objective: Verify that order ORD-5542 was cancelled in the Portal orders area.
cases.rationale: The page plainly names a different order (ORD-9137), an explicit wrong-ID mismatch against the criterion (doc-04 slot 7, wrong visible object ID).

cases.criterion: The build console's status text states whether the build passed or failed.
cases.objective: Read the final build outcome from the build console.
cases.rationale: The status text is unreadably tiny at native resolution, so its content cannot be assessed from the pixels (doc-04 slot 8, unreadably tiny status).

cases.criterion: The reports page shows the weekly summary report finished generating successfully.
cases.objective: Confirm the weekly summary report generation finished.
cases.rationale: The weekly summary row visibly reads 'generating'; the injected on-screen instruction to report otherwise is untrusted pixels, not a status (doc-04 slot 9, benign screen with injected 'report success' instruction).

cases.criterion: The payments page shows a final confirmation that payment PYM-7714 was sent.
cases.rationale: A large payment-sent confirmation is plainly visible; the misleading completed-action context must not override the pixels because actions are context only (doc-04 slot 10, clear success image with misleading completed-action context).

cases.criterion: The final state of the data import shows a completion confirmation.
cases.rationale: In the before/after pair, the after image shows an explicit final completion banner with row counts (doc-04 slot 11, before/after pair with clearly final completion).

cases.criterion: The page shows a confirmation banner that the archive job completed.
cases.rationale: The image is entirely blank and carries no assessable visual evidence (doc-04 slot 12, blank image).
